_note: Rules for using tokens in PageSpecs. Hand-authored policy over the GENERATED catalog: every category name here is a real key of tokens/llm/token-catalog.json counts.byCategory, every slot is a real property of the PageSpec `tokens` object, every listed token path exists in the catalog - extraction/verify_all.py resolves all three and fails on a dangling name. schema/semantic_validate.py enforces the rules (TOKEN_* in compatibility/graph.json).

catalogOnlyCategories.color: Foundation colours are catalogued for traceability; a PageSpec names the semantic alias (semanticColor) the theme resolves, never the foundation path.
catalogOnlyCategories.fontFamily: Families are reached through typography.* roles only (a role pins family + weight + size + line-height + tracking together).
catalogOnlyCategories.breakpoint: Breakpoints belong to section contracts' responsive[] (structured, cited); a PageSpec cannot set them.
catalogOnlyCategories.component: Component tokens are owned by the primitive/component contracts; a PageSpec cannot restyle a component.
catalogOnlyCategories.motionPattern: Motion patterns are chosen per node in node.motion.patterns (closed per section), not in the tokens slot.

notApproved.fontFamily.mock-web: Arial is only used inside the third-party mock sites of the browser-task scene; not a site font.
notApproved.fontFamily.demo-system: System UI stack of the scripted desktop demos; not a site font.
notApproved.layout.section.root-font-size: 62.5% root sizing is a stylesheet mechanism, not a design choice a page can make.

rawValueRestrictions.summary: No raw values in any PageSpec token slot: every slot value must be a catalog token path that is approvedForPageSpec. Raw values are classified so the error says what was wrong.

aliasAndFallbackRules.aliasDirection: PageSpec -> semantic alias (color.text.*, color.surface.*, typography.*) -> foundation token -> value. A PageSpec never names the foundation target of an alias; verify_all.py checks every semantic $ref resolves and the theme resolves every semantic colour.
aliasAndFallbackRules.noRawFallback: There is no fallback to a raw value: an unknown or unapproved path is an error (TOKEN_UNKNOWN / TOKEN_NOT_APPROVED), never silently replaced.
aliasAndFallbackRules.fontFallback: Font fallbacks live INSIDE the fontFamily token value (Exposure -> Georgia -> serif; Open Runde -> sans-serif). Exposure and Open Runde are font files shipped with the clone (ASSET_MANIFEST.json fonts); a mode=generation renderer without its own licence for them must render the token's fallback stack. A PageSpec cannot name a fallback family itself.
aliasAndFallbackRules.componentRefs: Component tokens reference semantic colours with {surface.cta-wipe}-style refs; verify_all.py resolves them.

themeRestrictions.note: The source has ONE theme (light). There is no dark theme; the black privacy scene is a section-local 'scene-dark' scheme rendered only by scene.privacy-trust, not a theme.
rules: theme must be a theme of the catalog (only 'light'); a token must be resolved by that theme
page-level surface/text/border must all be in the theme's base scheme ('light'); scene-dark tokens are section-local to scene.privacy-trust and are rejected as page tokens
text on surface must reach a WCAG contrast ratio of at least minTextContrast in the theme's resolved values

modeRules.generation: All approvedForPageSpec tokens allowed: tokens are the reusable design system, not source identity. Brand identity is carried by assets/copy (blocked by GENERATION_MODE_* rules), and font licensing follows aliasAndFallbackRules.fontFallback.
